```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

students <- read_csv("../outputs/students_clean.csv")
hostels <- read_csv("../outputs/hostels_clean.csv")
bookings <- read_csv("../outputs/bookings_clean.csv")
```

# PgBee Beta Summary

```{r}
total_students <- nrow(students)
total_hostels <- nrow(hostels)
total_bookings <- nrow(bookings)
total_revenue <- sum(bookings$commission_amount)

summary_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Students",
    "Hostels",
    "Bookings",
    "Revenue"
  ),
  Value = c(
    total_students,
    total_hostels,
    total_bookings,
    total_revenue
  )
)

summary_table
```

# Revenue Per Booking

```{r}
total_revenue / total_bookings
```

# Revenue Per Hostel

```{r}
total_revenue / total_hostels
```
